# CANDIDATE: COMBINED_STRUCTURE_AND_TRENDLINE_VETO

**Filed:** 2026-08-20  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** quality_gate  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Combining structural trend veto (blocking P-in-uptrend/C-in-downtrend) with trendline-break call veto (blocking calls on broken ascending support) will capture more loser-day avoidance while preserving winner-day trades. The structural veto already removes bearish PUTs in uptrends (net -$574 from 2 wrong-way losers). Adding the call veto should block the 5/07 CALL losers (-$165) without affecting PUT winners, increasing edge_capture by ~$165. We hypothesize the combined gate will maintain or improve Sharpe by removing losing trades without adding whipsaw.

## Mechanism

**Entry path:**  
1. Compute `market_structure.classify_trend` on 5m same-day bars (from `market_structure.py`).  
2. Compute `trendline_break_call_veto` detector (from `trendline_break_call_veto.py`) which fires on 5m-close-through-respected-ascending-support (BROKEN) as CALL VETO signal.  
3. Block entry if:  
   - (side == "P" and trend == "uptrend") OR (side == "C" and trend == "downtrend") [structural veto]  
   - OR (side == "C" and trendline_break_call_veto == True) [call veto]  
4. Allow entry only if both veto conditions are false.  
**Exit logic:** Unchanged — uses existing v15 TP1/runner/chandelier/time-stop rules.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+ account; $1K paper ~= 14% headline P&L (per risk-rules.md position sizing).  
2. **Sample bias:** Using 16-month dataset (2025-01-02 to 2026-06-18) with walk-forward OOS on last 4 months (2026-02-19 to 2026-06-18). Selection method: deterministic backtest over fixed window. Overfit risk: medium — combines two existing gates with individual guards passed, but interaction not yet tested.  
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (walk-forward held-out window not yet run; will verify Sharpe >=0.70 on last 4 months).  
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (top 3 J days validation not yet done; will check <20% deviation from BS-simulated P&L).  
5. **Failure modes:**  
   - Worst day: Unexpected trendline break on winner day causing missed entry (e.g., 5/04 if false break structure). Mitigated by requiring respect-level condition.  
   - Max drawdown: Estimated < -$2,500 based on base engine DD (-$2,273) plus potential whipsaw losses.  
   - Blow-up scenario: Chronic false trendline breaks in choppy markets causing excessive veto and missed winners; monitored via quarterly hit rate.  
6. **Concentration:** Top-5 days = ~45% of P&L (estimated from base engine; combined veto preserves winner concentration while reducing loser impact).
